posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
Speaking of the unidentified man in red and gold, after seeing him, I thought I recognized the colors of a boot and part of a leg in the Realm of Discord. I forget what the card's real name is, but I think it's "Claustrophobic Disallusion" or something. So he's in the Realm of Discord at some point. Assuming that is actually his foot and leg.

Maybe he's the second hero in Time & Space? I guess he'd be the "Space" to CR's "Time", if he is the other one (which would explain him being in an interdimensional realm). Anyone else think it's possible?  I'd say he's at least got a good chance of showing up at some point since it'd be weird to have this Prime Wardens team and leave one of the members out of the game.

Then again, Fanatic's bio doesn't list her as affiliated with the Prime Wardens, so maybe it's just a coincidence that three of the people pictured are associated with this group.

However, when it comes to SotM, I don't believe in coincidences. I think I'll throw in my chips with this guy being a new hero in this expansion. I think we've got solid reasoning. Also, I have no other guesses than this guy as to the second hero, so it's all or nothing.
